anomalies.observed: In the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block the 22 nF capacitor C1, the series resistor R12 (1 k), the touch electrode A1/BTN and the two hierarchical labels NET0004 and NET0018 all terminate on a single continuous wire. NET0004 is the TSC sampling-capacitor net (U2 pin 59 / PB7) and NET0018 is the electrode net (U2 pin 57 / PB5), so the drawing shorts PB5 to PB7 and places the 22 nF sampling capacitor in parallel with the electrode line instead of on the dedicated Cs pin.
anomalies.expected: The two TSC nets must be separate: PB5 (NET0018) should connect through the 1 k series resistor to the electrode (A1/BTN), while PB7 (NET0004) should connect only through the 22 nF sampling capacitor to GND. Spec: 'TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN' and 'TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group'.

anomalies.impact: The STM32 Touch Sensing Controller group is miswired: the two group pins (PB5 and PB7) are shorted together and the sampling capacitor is loaded onto the electrode path rather than the Cs pin. Capacitive touch sensing will not operate as designed (wrong/shorted sense capacitance, conflicting channels), so the touch button is non-functional or erratic.
